response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and 20 years of development experience, there is a critical mismatch with this role's core requirements. The position requires an experienced C++ developer with 8-12 years in embedded systems and industrial automation, but this candidate's experience is primarily in web/backend development (TypeScript, Node.js). C++ work is limited to 6 months in 2014-2015. More significantly, the resume shows zero exposure to the industrial cybersecurity domain (IEC 62443, SDL practices), MQTT protocol, or industrial automation—all core to this role. This represents a fundamental domain and technology stack mismatch rather than a skills gap that can be bridged.
strengths: Extensive software engineering background (20 years) with proven ability to learn diverse technologies and languages
Strong software craftsmanship mindset with demonstrated expertise in testing, CI/CD, architecture design, and mentoring practices
Experience building scalable, high-performance systems handling millions of requests with event-driven architectures and microservices
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015) with no recent C++ work despite role requiring 8-12 years as primary developer
Complete absence of industrial automation, cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, SDL), or MQTT protocol experience—all core to the role
Recent career trajectory (past 10+ years) focused on web/backend development, not embedded systems or industrial applications
